Great question! For your first time, the main thing is to make sure you have the right size and use the footwear according to its sole type. Our slippers are generally medium width, and you should normally buy the same size as your shoe size; if your measurements fall between sizes, pick the next larger size. Many styles have easy on/off designs and memory foam cushioning, so they’re meant to be slipped on and worn comfortably right away!

If you plan to wear them outside, check that the product has an indoor/outdoor sole, since only some slippers are made for outdoor wear. If the style is machine washable, wash it on a gentle cycle and air dry it; do not put slippers in the dryer because that can cause them to misshape.
